## Purpose
The refine conversation: each instruction and what came of it, with the composer underneath, which offers one-click prompts drawn from what is wrong with the workflow now.

## Responsibilities
- `RefineConversation`:
- - `SuggestionChips` (from the revision suggestions);
- - `EmptyConversation` ("Tell me what to change");
- - focus chips for steps picked on the canvas;
- - an auto-growing composer.
